review_evidence: All eight formal-source files in the unit were inspected directly.
EvmAsm.lean is the library import umbrella and remains retained as navigation metadata; the seven Main*.lean files are executable or report entrypoints.
Five checker mains and Main.lean only import retained modules and delegate to their main functions; MainProgress renders retained EvmAsm.Progress registries into PROGRESS.md/DRIFT.md text.

rules.content_invariant: Excluding these wrappers loses no unique EVM definition, theorem, proof, specification, or reusable semantic interface: their behavior delegates to retained modules or formats data owned by retained Progress registries.
evidence: Main.lean delegates to EvmAsm.Codegen.Cli.main; the five checker mains each delegate to the imported retained checker module.
MainProgress imports EvmAsm.Progress modules and defines private formatting/rendering functions plus the reporting entrypoint; the registries and proof-status data themselves remain retained.
rules.rationale: These exact root files are executable and report-entrypoint scaffolding rather than owners of EVM formalization results.

summary: Reviewed the repository-root unit; retain the EvmAsm import surface and exclude only seven executable/report entrypoint wrappers whose substantive implementations remain in retained modules.
